title: What my QuotaPath spec forgot

segments.text: Here's how to reverse engineer QuotaPath from a written spec. Claude passed all twenty-four checks, but my spec never said whose share a split meant.
The full spec is free at personal software factory dot com. If you build it, tell me what broke. I'm Sam. See you tomorrow.
